data.gender_notes: Qudairah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'qada', meaning to decree or ordain, Qudairah is a name of majestic and glorious origin. It is a name that evokes a sense of the divine decree, the natural order of things, and the beauty and power of the universe. The name Qudairah carries the meaning “Majestic, Glorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Qudairah usually hope their child will grow to embody majestic, glorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qudairah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

It is also a name that reflects the Islamic value of submission to the will of Allah (Tawhid and Ihsan), which is a core tenet of the faith.

It is a reminder of the divine decree and the beauty and power of the universe, which is an essential aspect of the Islamic faith. The name signifies a sense of submission to the divine will and an understanding of the natural order of things. It is also a source of inspiration and encouragement, reminding us of the ultimate sovereignty of Allah and the importance of trusting in His plan for us. As such, the name Qudairah is a powerful invocation of the divine presence and a reminder of the interconnectedness of all things in the universe.
